name: Yancheng

queries.query: 盐城市不动产登记中心 地籍图 盐城市地理信息公共服务平台 地块
queries.scope: Identify municipal land registry and public GIS data scope, including parcel-vector availability.
queries.result: City government identifies the municipal registration center and natural-resources bureau’s cadastral-rights and registration duties. The 2026 public mapping release offers topographic, imagery, terrain, 3D and Tianditu services, but does not list cadastral lot polygons.

queries.query: Yancheng China official city cadastral parcel map land registration GIS public data
queries.scope: Cross-check the municipal public map platform and registration service in English-indexed sources.
queries.result: Official city sources confirm an updated geographic-information public platform and municipal property registration. No English-accessible source or inspected service exposed anonymous full parcel vectors; public map products are described as base geography and addresses/POIs.

portals.name: Yancheng Natural Resources and Planning Bureau / Municipal Real Estate Registration Center
portals.operator: Yancheng Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau
portals.observation: City agency duties include natural-resource and property-right registration, cadastral investigation, real-estate surveying, and a municipal real-estate registration center.

portals.name: Yancheng Geographic Information Public Service Platform / Tianditu Yancheng
portals.operator: Yancheng Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau / municipal geospatial information center
portals.observation: City announced updated public mapping products available online; documented layers include base topographic data, orthophotography, elevation models, 3D city content, vector/imagery basemaps, addresses and POIs, not cadastral lots.

portals.name: Yancheng municipal e-government registration services
portals.operator: Jiangsu Provincial Government Service Data Bureau / Yancheng service center
portals.observation: Official city service portal provides Yancheng real-estate registration applications; no property-specific application was made.

requests.observation: Official city organization page identifies municipal registration and cadastral survey responsibilities and the city registration center.
Official 2026 mapping release details public base-data categories and online access route; it does not list lot/parcel vectors.
Official city e-government service portal lists city real-estate registration; account or record lookup was not attempted.

source.serviceType: City registry/cadastral administration and public base-mapping platform; no anonymous general parcel vector endpoint verified.
source.geometryType: No cadastral parcel vector schema verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: City-owned sources confirm cadastral and real-estate-registration responsibilities plus an updated public base-map service. Published open map content is base geography and addresses/POIs rather than parcel lots.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: City-owned sources confirm cadastral and real-estate-registration responsibilities plus an updated public base-map service. Published open map content is base geography and addresses/POIs rather than parcel lots.

technicalBlocker: The public platform’s documented online layers are basic mapping and 3D products, not cadastral lots. No public full-polygon service was located.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a separate municipal or district public cadastral service exists beyond the inspected geographic platform and city service portal.
nextStep: Seek only a city-published anonymous parcel-vector endpoint with server-side geometry and ID-only selection; avoid e-government record/application workflows.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official city agency responsibilities include property-right registration, cadastral surveys and a municipal Real Estate Registration Center; 2026 mapping products are public base layers.
